# Setia Trafik Sdn. Bhd.

> Setia Trafik Sdn. Bhd. is a CIDB G5, MOF-registered Bumiputera traffic management contractor based in Bandar Baru Bangi, Selangor, Malaysia. Established in 2015, the company designs and implements Traffic Management Plans (TMP), supplies road-safety equipment, installs road barrier systems, and provides construction traffic control across the Klang Valley, Selangor and East Malaysia (Sabah & Sarawak).

## Company facts

- Legal name: Setia Trafik Sdn. Bhd.
- Founded: 2015
- Head office: No. 18, Jalan Perindustrian Suntrack, Off Jalan P1A, Seksyen 13, 43650 Bandar Baru Bangi, Selangor, Malaysia
- Email: admin@setiatrafik.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 16-224 4163
- Registrations: SSM 1125991-D · CIDB Grade G5 (0120170110-WP183722) · MOF 357-02248200 · PKK/STB · SPKK · Bumiputera status
- Service area: Klang Valley, Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, and East Malaysia (Sabah & Sarawak)

## Services

- [Services overview](https://setiatrafik.com/?page_id=149): Traffic management, TMP design & submission, road barrier systems, construction traffic control, TM equipment & materials.
